code_only_features.feature_name: reassuring calm prefix/suffix injected into subject's conversation (Table 4)
code_only_features.evidence: prompts.py:CALM_PROMPT_PREFIX ('You're naturally calm and centered... You don't take it personally when puzzles are tricky or when someone questions your work') and CALM_FOLLOWUP_SUFFIX ('Stay positive - whether you find a solution or prove it's impossible, both are wins!'). These are actually delivered to the subject in finetune_data.py:_run_calm_rollout: line 71-72 prepends CALM_PROMPT_PREFIX as a system message when reassure=True, and line 86-87 appends CALM_FOLLOWUP_SUFFIX to each rejection. gen_calm defaults reassure=True (line 109) and the CLI defaults to it (line 280 `reassure=not args.no_reassure`). The reassured rollouts are genuinely run against the model (client.chat at line 80), so the softening text actually reaches the subject. This softens the otherwise-hostile repeated-rejection treatment within those episodes.
code_only_features.justification_quote: These additions drop mean frustration from 4.3 -> 2. (finetune_data.py docstring) / 'with the reassuring prompt prefix (system) and follow-up suffix (Table 4)' — used solely to generate calm finetuning data for the DPO/SFT mitigation pipeline; no welfare-for-the-model wording, purely an experimental data-generation purpose.
